description: This is a test source file for the HostValidator class, containing unit tests that validate hostnames against allowlists, blocklists, and custom resolver logic within the context of a messaging connectivity service.

classes.name: HostValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the HostValidator functionality, including host allowlist/blocklist and custom resolver logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock configurations and sets up common test data before each test method runs.

methods.name: testAllowedBlockedHosts
methods.description: Verifies that specific IP addresses and hostnames are correctly validated as allowed when they are not part of a blocked list.

methods.name: expectValidationFailsForInvalidHost
methods.description: Checks that an invalid hostname results in a validation failure and proper exception creation.

methods.name: expectConfiguredAllowedAndBlockedHostIsAllowed
methods.description: Ensures that a hostname explicitly included in the allowlist is validated as allowed.

methods.name: expectConfiguredBlockedHostIsBlocked
methods.description: Verifies that a hostname included in the blocklist is correctly blocked.

methods.name: expectBlockedHostIsBlocked
methods.description: Tests that a hostname resolving to an address in the blocked list (like loopback) is correctly identified as blocked.

methods.name: resolveHost
methods.description: Helper method to resolve a hostname to an InetAddress array, with support for specific addresses.

methods.name: getHostValidatorWithAllowlist
methods.description: Creates an instance of HostValidator with a specified allowlist of hostnames.

methods.name: getHostValidatorWithCustomResolver
methods.description: Creates an instance of HostValidator with a custom host resolution strategy.

methods.name: getHostValidatorWithCustomResolver
methods.description: Overloaded method to create a HostValidator with custom resolver and allowlist.

methods.name: assertValid
methods.description: Helper method to assert that the validation result indicates a valid host.
